work_branch_base.rationale: Cut from current HEAD rather than literally from backend_migration. backend_migration is a strict ancestor (46 commits behind, 0 ahead) and predates Stage 0: it lacks the C1/C2/C3 CLAUDE.md amendments, the milestone decision record, tickets.md, and the tickets 1-2 engine work. Cutting from HEAD is 'off the backend_migration line' while preserving that foundation. Operator-confirmed.

archive_branch.purpose: Preserves the runnable MAESTRO/RIA demo end-to-end for regression safety (the pre-purge state).

embedded_msca_vault.topology: Embedded git repo referenced as a gitlink (mode 160000); NOT a registered submodule (no .gitmodules). Submodule-vs-absorb topology deferred to D8.
embedded_msca_vault.handling: Operator decision: record the current gitlink SHA as re-instantiation provenance; do NOT commit the vault's uncommitted changes. A byte-exact clean pin-and-record is deferred (D8/D10).
embedded_msca_vault.provenance_note: This SHA pins the source vault used for re-instantiation. Because the working tree was left dirty and uncommitted, the recorded SHA reflects the last committed gitlink, not the current working tree.

topology_resolution_d8.what_happened: The embedded MSCA/ git repo (gitlink mode 160000 at b4d9e57, no .gitmodules) was ABSORBED into the parent repo: the gitlink was removed from the parent index (git rm --cached MSCA), the standalone MSCA/.git was removed, and MSCA/** is now tracked as ordinary files under the parent repo. Submodule was rejected because the standalone repo is local-only (no remote/origin), so a .gitmodules URL could not point anywhere clonable, and because the vault is the tightly-coupled milestone-2 authoring surface of THIS repo (ticket 5 template home + Dataview enable, --from-graph stable path).
topology_resolution_d8.pin_sha_traceability: b4d9e57 (recorded_gitlink_sha above) remains traceable and REPRODUCIBLE: the standalone repo's complete history (refs/heads/master @ b4d9e57, HEAD @ b4d9e57, refs/stash) was archived to MSCA-preabsorb-b4d9e57.bundle (git bundle --all, verified 'complete history') at the repo root before MSCA/.git was removed. `git clone MSCA-preabsorb-b4d9e57.bundle` restores the pre-absorb vault. The provenance record is UPDATED, not silently broken (ticket 2 acceptance).
tracked_after_absorb: MSCA/methodology_graph/** (87 graph nodes — the reader/--from-graph target)
MSCA/.obsidian/plugins/** + community-plugins.json (self-contained vault; Dataview present for ticket 5)
topology_resolution_d8.stable_vault_path: MSCA/methodology_graph/ is the stable, in-tree node root the deterministic vault reader (runner/vault_reader.py, ticket 1) and the ticket-3 --from-graph compiler read. It is unchanged by the absorb; it is now a plain in-tree path requiring no submodule init.
topology_resolution_d8.generic_template_home: templates/obsidian_graph_vault/ (repo root) is fixed as the generic (no-project-nouns) template home for ticket 5's obsidian-graph scaffolding skill. MSCA/methodology_graph/ is reference instance #1; the generic template is authored into templates/obsidian_graph_vault/ in ticket 5.
